integrity: The complete 225-support-pair finite certificate is embedded as a standalone reproducible verifier; numerical tests on finite labelled graphs corroborate but do not replace the exact support reduction and surjection proof. Not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Proves exactly the recurrent periods and labelled periodic-state populations for the synchronous four-color threshold-one successor rule on nonempty finite complete bipartite graphs. Does not determine transient times, basin sizes, or other graphs/palettes. Historical equivalence beyond examined sources is not excluded.
title: A complete fixed-, four-, and six-cycle census for four-color cyclic competition on bicliques
